name: usage-meter
description: Live usage meter under the prompt with context fill, rate-limit windows, session cost and token totals

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: inline: after the hint under the prompt, dim. below: on its own line under the hint, with coloured bars.

showContext.title: Show context
showContext.description: Context window fill, with its bar.

showFiveHour.title: Show 5h limit
showFiveHour.description: How much of the 5-hour rate-limit window is used.

showSevenDay.title: Show 7d limit
showSevenDay.description: How much of the 7-day rate-limit window is used.

showResetTimes.title: Show reset times
showResetTimes.description: When each rate-limit window resets, after its bar.

showCost.title: Show cost
showCost.description: What the session has cost so far, in US dollars.

showTokens.title: Show tokens
showTokens.description: Input and output tokens of every API request this session.

showRequests.title: Show requests
showRequests.description: How many API requests this session made.
